title: Harlan Coben's Lazarus: Sam Claflin Investigates Father's Death | First Look
text:
Sam Claflin to Star in Harlan Coben ’s New Thriller, Lazarus , Premiering October 22 on Prime Video A gripping new mystery is headed to Amazon’s Prime Video this fall. Lazarus , a limited series starring Sam Claflin and Bill Nighy , will debut on October 22 in over 240 countries and territories worldwide, promising a complex narrative of psychological suspense and long-buried secrets.
The Story Unfolds: A Forensic Psychologist’s Descent Claflin portrays Joel Lazarus, a forensic psychologist thrust into a harrowing investigation following his father’s suicide. However, the case quickly spirals beyond a personal tragedy as Lazarus becomes entangled in a web of unsolved cold case murders . The series promises a dark and twisting journey as he navigates disturbing experiences that defy explanation.
A Proven Creative Team Returns Lazarus marks the second collaboration between author Harlan Coben and writer Danny Brocklehurst for Prime Video. The duo previously found success with the Netflix hits Fool Me Once , Stay Close , and The Stranger . According to a company release, the team behind Fool Me Once has reunited for this new project. This is Coben’s second venture with Prime Video, following the cancellation of his first series, Shelter .
Cast and Creative Leadership Alongside Claflin and Nighy, the series boasts a strong ensemble cast including Alexandra Roach as Jenna Lazarus, David Fynn as Seth McGovern, Karla Crome as Bella Catton, and Kate Ashfield as Detective Alison Brown. Wayne Che Yip directs the first two episodes, with Harlan Coben, Danny Brocklehurst, Nicola Shindler, Richard Fee, Claflin, and Che Yip serving as executive producers. Matt Strevens produces through Amazon MGM Studios, Quay Street Productions, and Final Twist Productions.
A Legacy of Mystery and Suspense Harlan Coben is renowned for his intricate plots and compelling characters, and Lazarus appears to continue that tradition. The narrative will force Lazarus to confront not only the mystery surrounding his father’s death but also the unresolved murder of his sister 25 years prior. The series is poised to deliver a thrilling and emotionally resonant experience for viewers, building on the success of Coben’s previous adaptations.
